parsed.name: NI数字输出设备
parsed.description: 这是一类美国国家仪器公司的数字输出数据采集设备或板卡，可通过多个数字通道输出高低电平信号，用于实验室中的TTL控制、设备触发、开关量控制和自动化联动。
parsed.description_en: This is a National Instruments digital output data acquisition device or board that provides multiple digital channels for outputting logic high/low signals, commonly used in laboratories for TTL control, instrument triggering, on/off switching, and automation interlocks.

actions.description: 初始化数字输出设备的配置参数。

Connect to the NI digital output hardware.

actions.description_en: Disconnect from the NI digital output hardware.

actions.description: 向数字输出通道写入电平值或开关状态。
actions.description_en: Write a logic level or switching state to the digital output channels.

actions.description: 扫描并更新可用的NI设备及其数字输出通道。
actions.description_en: Scan and update the available NI devices and their digital output channels.
